Description.BullyDetail: It's against the rules to say mean things to someone or about another person.
Description.BullyImportance: To keep Boiby fun and safe for everyone, don’t use words or actions that are intended to harm or bully others.
Heading.RuleExplanation.PIIHeader: Don't share or request personal information
Description.PIIDetail: It's against the rules to share personal information or ask others to share theirs. This includes phone numbers, email addresses, real names, and addresses.
Description.PIIImportance: Information shared with a bad actor can be used to harm you. This can lead to bullying, threats, or identity theft.
Description.SpamDetail: Spam involves repetitive, unwanted, or automated messages or posts, and isn't allowed.
Description.SpamImportance: Spamming harms the experience for others and makes it hard to follow conversations.
Description.ExtortionDetail: Threatening or coercing others for money, favors, or to gain something you want isn't allowed.
Description.ExtortionImportance: Extortion and blackmail can be harmful or dangerous as it threatens users' safety and privacy.
Description.ViolentDetail: Content that depicts or promotes serious physical harm, graphic violence, or gore isn't allowed.
Description.ViolentImportance: Graphic or violent content can be traumatic or upsetting, especially for users under 18.
Description.DatingDetail: Romantic behaviors like kissing, dating, or sexting are not allowed. Keep conversations friendly, not flirty.
Description.DatingImportance: Our community includes users under the age of 18. Online dating puts these users at risk.
Description.HarmfulDetail: Content that encourages, instructs, or praises dangerous activities isn't allowed.
Description.HarmfulImportance: Encouraging or providing instructions for dangerous activities can cause real-world harm.
Heading.SexualHeaderTop: Keep it appropriate for all ages
Description.SexualDetail: Highly suggestive or sexual content isn't allowed. This includes profile pictures and usernames, too.
Description.SexualImportance: Sexual content is not appropriate for all audiences and can harm users or make them uncomfortable, especially younger users.
Description.ImpersonationDetail: Pretending to be someone else or misrepresenting your identity isn't allowed. This includes impersonating Boiby staff members or administrators.
Description.ImpersonationImportance: Impersonation can mislead or confuse others, and may harm the reputation of the person being impersonated.
Description.MisusingSystemsDetail: Misusing our reporting tools or attempting to bypass our safety and security systems breaks our rules and isn't allowed.
Description.MisusingSystemsImportance: Our systems are in place to keep our platform and users safe and secure. Bypassing or misusing these sytems can compromise the safety and integrity of our platform.
Description.UndisclosedAdsDetail: Posting promotional content without disclosure or without using our advertisement systems isn't allowed.
Description.UndisclosedAdsImportance: Honesty and transparency about advertisements and proper use helps maintain trust within the community.
Description.MisinformationDetail: Spreading false or misleading information that can cause harm to users or communities isn't allowed.
Description.MisinformationImportance: Misleading information can be harmful to users and communities, especially regarding serious topics.
Description.PoliticalDetail: Any content that directly or indirectly promotes, mentions, or discusses political figures or entities isn't allowed.
Description.PoliticalImportance: To ensure a neutral platform for all users, we don't allow content that promotes political figures or entities.
Heading.RuleExplanation.SensitiveEventsH: Don't take advantage of sensitive events
Description.SensitiveEventsDetail: Taking advantage of or exploiting real-world sensitive events for personal gain or attention isn't allowed.
Description.SensitiveEventsImportance: Exploiting sensitive events can cause harm or distress to those affected and is disrespectful to anyone involved.
Description.ScammingDetail: Attempting to scam or deceive users for personal gain through any means isn't allowed. This includes phishing links or fake offers.
Description.ScammingImportance: Scamming and deception can cause financial loss or identity theft, harming users and damaging trust within the community.
Heading.DisruptiveAudioHeaderTop: Use your voice to contribute, not disrupt
Description.DisruptiveAudioDetail: Audio content that is disruptive, overly loud, or harmful isn't allowed. This includes screaming and loud or annoying noises.
Description.DisruptiveAudioImportance: Disruptive or loud audio can be painful or startling, and can ruin the experience for others.
Description.ChargebackDetail: Submitting multiple refund requests or making chargebacks without a valid reason is not allowed. This includes disputing legitimate transactions through your bank.
Description.ChargebackImportance: Unfair chargebacks and refund abuse create financial problems and prevent us from providing a quality service to all users.
Heading.IllegalContentHeaderTop: Keep our community safe and compliant
Description.IllegalContentDetail: The promotion, sale, or discussion of illegal items, controlled substances, or regulated goods is prohibited on our platform.
Description.IllegalContentImportance: Discussion of illegal or regulated goods or services puts our members at risk and threatens the safety of our community, especially those under 18.
Description.IPViolationDetail: Uploading content that you do not own the rights to, including copyrighted music, videos, and art, is not allowed without permission.
Description.IPViolationImportance: Protecting other users' intellectual property ensures that creators are fairly credited for their work.
